ceiling_directive: Complete the universal frontier by proving a legal full-oracle transcript lower bound and an adaptive parent-blocking upper bound that match an explicit evaluable Q(n,K,d,tau,s) within universal constants for every feasible s.
improvement_directive: Resolve oeq:universal-frontier by constructing simultaneously faithful baseline alternatives whose distinguishing families yield the required blocker-packing converse, and match them with an adaptive parent-blocking policy. Supply either a proof or a precise theorem-level citation for the I-mixture Markov property used in the faithful-realization argument.
critique: The advertised five-parameter adaptive minimax count is not characterized: the universal-factor frontier and the general tree and cycle-free formulas remain open. What is proved generally is an exact intervention-size feasibility boundary and a nonadaptive blocker-cover upper bound with no matching all-parameter count converse; exact counts are confined to three narrow slices. This makes the delivered contribution a specialized companion result rather than the promised field-level resource law, and materially limits its leading-journal score. Moreover, the necessity results and exact-slice lower bounds rely on the faithful-witness realization theorem, whose proof invokes an I-mixture Markov property that is merely stated, without proof or a precise theorem-level citation. The TL;DR and scope sections disclose the open frontier, so the deficiency is substantive rather than a stale framing overclaim. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
